svg.title: Shinrai Ou — Throne of Thunder. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Storm classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mandate of Thunder forks into Vajra Tempering then Thunder King's Wrath, or Lightning Rod then Judgement from Above. Raiment of Storms forks into Galvanic Rebuke then Thunder Answers Thunder. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu.

The pre-batch +5 Damage route took Daibutsu Thunder to 55, Railgun to 50 and both 40s up a tier. Burst now follows the Blood-Enchanted Eyes pattern instead: Vajra Tempering sets up by charging the three compounding self buffs (two on the 40 AP Storm Cloak, one on Raijin), and Thunder King's Wrath pays off with a controlled +2 Damage (50 \u2192 52, 45 \u2192 47, 40 \u2192 42). Mandate of Thunder answers \"How do I make my thunder land harder: charge myself or expose them?\" with Burst and with Judgement from Above's Hammer exposure (+10%). Raiment of Storms answers \"How do I make attackers pay for striking me?\" with the Cloak's Reflect (+10%). BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Thunder Answers Thunder"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, the same shape as before the batch. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1), and each Advanced Art owns one idea: burst (self-charge setup into +2 Damage), exposure (Hammer) and retaliation (the Cloak's Reflect). A fourth capstone would twin one of them: a pure Increase Damage Given route would reuse Vajra Tempering's three compounding rows, whose compounding holds them to about +5%, so it would be Burst without its payoff; a second exposure or Reflect route would split a single row; a second Damage route would repeat the 50 \u2192 52 payoff. Mandate of Thunder forks into Burst and Exposure and Raiment of Storms carries the single Reflect chain, so Mandate of Thunder is a universal node (in all 8 legal full builds): Raiment's 3-BP chain needs a fourth purchase and Mandate is the only prerequisite-closed one. A Hidden Art leaf under Raiment would be filler: a Reflect leaf lifts Reflect past +10%, an Increase Damage Given leaf is a one-point sliver or, with Vajra Tempering, pushes the three compounding rows past +5%, an exposure leaf twins Lightning Rod, and a Damage leaf puts flat Damage on a Hidden Art. Burst and Exposure each keep two fourth-purchase choices; Retaliation has one.","design_notes":["Damage: Thunder King's Wrath is the only Damage node (+2), so every legal allocation ends at Daibutsu Thunder 50 \u2192 52, Divine Railgun 45 \u2192 47 and Izanagi's Hammer and Strike: Raijin 40 \u2192 42 EP, or adds no flat Damage. 52 is past the 50 Nuke tier under the Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura precedent (see above_nuke_rationale); no other row changes tier, and the pre-batch +5 route (50 \u2192 55, 45 \u2192 50, 40 \u2192 45) stays retired. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +4%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Reflect +10%.","Increase Damage Given leverage: both Cloak rows match the kit's Storm hits (row 0 via its Highest stat filter, row 2 via Storm) and compound with Raijin's row, so each point counts two or three times on one hit: at the +4% maximum the Cloak alone goes \u00d71.35\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.82 \u2192 \u00d71.39\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.93 and all three \u00d72.46 \u2192 \u00d72.69 (\u00d71.09). This is one of the roster's two fastest three-row stacks (Cloak 40 AP plus Raijin 60 AP in one 100 AP turn, no item gate), so it stays below the +5% that slower three-row stacks hold. The bloodline passive (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies last. The buffs also reach normal jutsu and weapons (row 0 and Raijin: Highest-stat or element-less hits; row 2: Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less).","Fourth purchases: Burst (01, 02, 03: +4% IDG, +2% IDT, +2 Damage) takes Lightning Rod (Hammer exposure 40%) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%); Exposure (01, 04, 05: +2% IDG, +10% IDT) takes Vajra Tempering (self buffs 39%) or Raiment of Storms; Retaliation (06, 07, 08) takes only Mandate of Thunder. In an all-windows-live model (three IDG rows, Hammer exposure, average flat-Damage gain \u00d71.046) Burst's package is about \u00d71.16 and \u00d71.18 with Lightning Rod; Exposure's is \u00d71.12 and \u00d71.17 with Vajra Tempering, and its exposure also lifts allies' hits. Both stay under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.19 top package. No capstone shares a tag with its sibling Hidden Art, and the Vajra setup is a self buff that does not feed Lightning Rod's mark.","Exposure magnitude: Judgement from Above's +10% sits on one area row, so a hit on an exposed enemy gains \u00d71.45/1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.074, the same per-hit lift as Shakunetsu Sakura's +5% on two exposure rows (\u00d71.40\u00b2/1.35\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.075).","Uptime: cooldown 7 on all five jutsu (attacks 60 AP, Cloak 40 AP). Each buff and the exposure is live only in the two rounds after its cast, never on its own jutsu's hit, so the +2 Damage payoff lands inside the self-buff windows when the Cloak or Raijin is cast first. The Cloak and Raijin buffs land on the caster at cast time; Hammer's exposure is a ground effect on its spiral around the caster, re-applied to enemies standing there.","Reflect and untouched rows: the Cloak Reflect row lists all four stat types and no element, so it matches effectively every hit the caster takes; the return bypasses shields, and other Reflect sources add to it up to the 60%-of-hit cap. Daibutsu's recoil 40%, Railgun's stun 100 and the two move rows are unsupported and unchanged; the bloodline passives (Increase Damage Given; 15% Decrease Damage Taken against Lightning) are not potency targets."],"risks":["Classification: Storm is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Arashima, Godstorm Eclipse and Stormboat Willy is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 6 of 9 kit rows carry Storm; the Cloak Reflect row and two of the three Increase Damage Given rows (Cloak row 0, Raijin) are element-less, so Retaliation and most of the Burst setup need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Storm coverage is unverified.","Damage tier: Thunder King's Wrath lifts Daibutsu Thunder 50 \u2192 52, above the 50 Nuke tier, as a controlled payoff under the RUL-2026-10-04-001/002 precedent; it needs director confirmation. proposal following the director precedent of Blood-Enchanted Eyes (RUL-2026-10-04-001) and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-002): Thunder King's Wrath's controlled +2 Damage, the payoff of the Vajra Tempering self-charge setup, lifts Storm Style: Daibutsu Thunder 50 \u2192 52, past the 50 Nuke tier. It is the tree's only Damage node, so no allocation exceeds +2 (Divine Railgun 45 \u2192 47, Izanagi's Hammer and Strike: Raijin 40 \u2192 42; no other tier crossed). g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Storm jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Thunder King's Wrath path + Lightning Rod
Judgement from Above path + Vajra Tempering
Thunder Answers Thunder path + Mandate of Thunder
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHINRAI OU KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Storm Cloak · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Storm classification / forked tree
